description.value: Mani is a Persian-fusion quick-service restaurant operated by Mani Food Services Ltd., offering a menu that blends traditional Iranian kabobs (koobideh, joojeh, lamb) with burgers, sandwiches, and sides. The combination of saffron chicken, rosemary lamb, and smoky eggplant preparations gives it a distinctly Middle Eastern flair unusual for a Marine Drive strip location. Cyclists passing through the West Vancouver corridor can order online for pickup or delivery, making a hot kabob plate an easy mid-ride fuel stop.
